name: ralph-fleet
north_star: One repo orchestrates Ralph Loops across entire GitHub account. Install Ralph on any repo with one command.
goal: Build the fleet orchestrator MVP: scan, install, status, sync

stories.title: GitHub API scaffold
stories.description: Set up authenticated GitHub API client with rate limiting
acceptance_criteria: Octokit client initialized from GITHUB_TOKEN env
Can list repos for authenticated user

stories.title: Scan command - list repos
stories.description: CLI command to scan and list repos with filters (updated in last N days, public/private, org)
acceptance_criteria: Output: repo name, last updated, has Ralph (y/n)

stories.title: Ralph detection - check if installed
stories.description: Detect if a repo has Ralph infrastructure (AGENTS.md, prd.json, progress.txt)

stories.title: Status command - fleet overview
stories.description: Show Ralph status across all repos in fleet
acceptance_criteria: bun run status shows table of repos
Columns: repo, ralph status, last commit, open stories
Summary: X/Y repos have Ralph installed

stories.title: Templates - Ralph infrastructure files
stories.description: Create template files that get installed on target repos

stories.title: Install command - add Ralph to repo
stories.description: Install Ralph infrastructure on a target repo via GitHub API

stories.title: Sync command - update fleet configs
stories.description: Push config updates to all Ralph-enabled repos
acceptance_criteria: bun run sync pushes template changes
Only updates repos with Ralph installed
Creates PRs, doesn't force-push to main

stories.title: Batch install - Ralph across fleet
stories.description: Install Ralph on multiple repos matching filter criteria
acceptance_criteria: bun run install --all installs on all matching repos

stories.title: GitHub Action workflow template
stories.description: Optional CI workflow that runs Ralph loops on push
acceptance_criteria: Optional: continues Ralph loop if stories remain

stories.title: Fleet report - markdown summary
stories.description: Generate markdown report of fleet status for README or publishing
acceptance_criteria: Shows all repos, Ralph status, health metrics
Can be committed to this repo as dashboard

rules.dry_run_first: All destructive operations must pass --dry-run before real execution
rules.rate_limiting: Sleep 1s between GitHub API calls to repos
rules.no_force_push: Never push directly to main on target repos, always PR
rules.idempotent: Running install twice should be safe (detect existing, skip or update)
